page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 24 dedicated physical cores with one thread per core, providing 24 vCPUs. The system is equipped with 93.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.88 GB per core. For acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA T4 GPU based on the Turing architecture with 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. This instance does not include local storage and relies on network-attached storage, while offering a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between CPU-only and GPU-accelerated workloads. Single-core CPU performance is relatively weak, scoring in the bottom 25% on stress-ng and Geekbench tests. Multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth fall within the average range. However, the integrated NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers strong performance for machine learning tasks. LLM inference benchmarks show top-tier prompt processing speeds, reaching 8,377 tokens per second for a small 135M model and 1,130 tokens per second for a medium 7B model. Text generation for the 7B model is also strong at 33.05 tokens per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn6i-c24g1.6xlarge offers a balanced entry point for GPU-accelerated computing without the high cost of top-tier enterprise accelerators. The lack of local storage requires external storage configuration, which represents a key architectural tradeoff. This server is highly suited for workloads such as low-to-medium scale LLM inference, machine learning model deployment, ray tracing, and video transcoding, while being less optimal for single-threaded CPU-bound tasks.
